]> 05/08/2026 7:24 5cm fresh snow and still snowing!.

We had another 5cm of snow recorded on the snow stake overnight, and it's still snowing this morning! The flakes are forecast to continue throughout the day, and we should see another few centimetres by the end of the day.

It's currently -1.7 degrees in Perisher Valley and the wind is a westerly 20 km/h. We have a forecast top of 1 degrees with the windchill making it feel colder, so layer up before heading out. Visibility is fairly impaired this morning with low cloud hanging around the mountains, so stick to the trees and use a low light lens.

Alongside the fresh snow, we had the snow guns firing overnight, kicking off at 5pm and still running this morning. With fresh snow and snowmaking, there should be some great turns out there this morning. And with 37 lifts scheduled to run and 46 groomed runs, there's plenty of space to find some fun!

Winds may again impact lift operations, so keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates, or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop.

Looking ahead, everyone is getting pretty excited for a storm set to roll in on Sunday night and deliver solid snowfall right through to Wednesday! Watch this space.
